name: The Machine That Wouldn't Go Ghost

description.value:
Requirement Drift 10 (Ghost in the Machine)

Duration constant

You retain full personal agency at all times — the GM narrates pressure and glitching, never puppeting, for you specifically. Every tech in Cyber City's heard the story by now: any NPC connected to Cyber City who hears your name reacts to it, unprompted, before they react to you.
